gaps.claim: A full-selector run that aborted in tests/meta has meta results only and still counts as the last full run.
Docstring headline and #119 promise 'made, or refused for a reason', but judge() passes any 4xx detail that merely omits 'try again' (e.g. 'Invalid clone request.').
A breach needs an earlier refusal with a byte-identical detail; a per-request id or timestamp in the message sends the refuted retry to unmeasured forever.
'try again' is a plain substring, so a fix that names its reason and says 'do not try again' still fails.
route_of() takes the first matching route, so a template listed before a literal route can claim the literal path and judge against the wrong schema.
Only `curl -X M url -d '{...}'` is read; --data, a double-quoted body, a quoted URL or -X after the URL are silently uncounted while the pass line says all examples hold.
required_of() resolves only a top-level $ref; allOf/anyOf/oneOf bodies read as requiring nothing.
Arena legs are a gap, but verdicts() still calls closes_at(ref), a live GET /api/v1/event-cards/BLUE per leg per due verdict.
The orphaned tick marker is handled by a skill rule, while tick_exclusive still trusts a dead pid's marker for 45 minutes.
The reminders mechanism still phrases maintenance lines as commands for the operator, contrary to [operator 2026-09-22]; only CLAUDE.md prose changed.
resolve() follows a name only when the whole expression is a bare name, so (s.building || 0) + nf with const nf = (s.funded || 0) passes; the funded stage is hidden behind a local.

credential_gap tests 'x-api-key' in headers case-sensitively, but a security scheme's name is added as written and their ApiKeyAuth is 'X-API-Key': a route declared through security reads as publishing only authorization.
r.get('rank') or 0 and str(created_at or '') turn missing fields into values; with no created_at or a renamed rank the check fails 'exactly newest-first' with nothing read.

(a) an empty 4xx body is stored as encoding empty/value null, their_body() returns None and the docstring's 'no detail at all -> fail' becomes inconclusive; (b) a reason not under top-level detail reads as no detail; (c) the no-detail breach is reported with the retry sentence; (d) clone_attempts never filters paper.
PAGE_STATUSES is our hard-coded copy, never read off the page the docstring names as the claimant, so a page change reads as a promise not served; a line body with no count passes.
CURL requires an unquoted URL, so curl -X POST "https://..." examples (two on the page today) are dropped silently, neither judged nor counted.

Checks only that five exact names are absent; os.system('git commit ...') added to night_promote stays green although the docstring says committing is not a door of the night (reproduced by the auditor).
The only longer-word case ('MACD Hunters') names a bot already proposed, so plain substring matching in _whole_names stays green (reproduced).
Docstring names the launcher as one of three places, but no test drives whole_linked in night_promote; room_key(row) is None -> not row.get('card') stays green.
Only checks 'Ukoncene' and 'nr.why' appear in the template; two of three 'Ukoncene' are comments, so keeping stopped rooms on the strip stays green.
Docstring says held whether or not paused; the fixture has no disable row, so skipping paused instances stays green.
Docstring says pausing does not release the money; no pause row in the fixture, so dropping disabled instances' transfers stays green.
Claims a team is one of two; only BLUE is shown accepted, so ARENA_TEAMS = ('BLUE',) stays green.
Docstring names gate-row keys bot:<species> and fund:<symbol>; nothing asserts them and brief() is only checked non-empty.

qa/safety.py lets a live order through: a JSON-RPC batch body (a list) is returned unchecked at MUTATE (safety.py ~271-274), and the REST required_flags check (_assert_declared_flags ~410) still reads not payload.get(flag), so paper='false' passes on event-card buy.

The test writes only accepted marks; deleting the outcome == 'accepted' filter in verify.py settle() stays green, and an unknown re-sent pass would become the newest mark so the obligation never clears.
fix_claimed is checked by the substring 'a fix was claimed', which the default wording also contains; deleting the branch stays green.
resolve() follows a name only when the whole expression is that name; (s.building || 0) + nf with nf = s.funded passes (same defect as A01, meta side).
_matches in test_nexus_routes_exist.py lets a placeholder in Nexus's text match a fixed published segment: /api/v1/exchange/{pair} matches /api/v1/exchange/pairs.
denies_identity is satisfied by denying either identity or trust level anywhere in the hint; 'not about your identity; it needs a higher trust level' passes.
DENIED looks for a negation only before the word; 'pro-forma periods are excluded' / 'Pro-forma figures are never used' read as disclosures and #116 would pass on a live defect.
The test stubs their_body; a real empty 400 is captured as encoding empty/value None, their_body returns None and the check goes inconclusive where the docstring says fail (same root as A04a).
A card_before recorded as unreadable ({'http_status': 503}) falls back to today's read with the false sentence 'the buy predates recording the card at the buy'.
FILING changes are checked only for a present event_id, not that it belongs to an event passed in; a fold citing an event never in the journal stays green.

meta_tests.reason: +4, each driving a path no existing test drove: the REST paper floor and a JSON-RPC batch (test_a_money_tool_with_a_paper_flag drives the MCP gate only), the real their_body over captured bodies for #119 (the existing test stubs it), every spelling of a curl on /api-docs (the existing test reads one), and night_promote with a bot room beside a card of the same answer (the existing rooms test drives open_strategy only). The rest are stricter asserts in existing tests.

rule_changes.what: qa/safety.py: the REST required_flags floor needs the flag to be True itself (not truthy), and a JSON-RPC batch body is checked call by call instead of returning unread at PROBE and MUTATE
rule_changes.why: C01 (3/3): paper 'false' passed an event-card buy at MUTATE, and a batch carried place_arena_order mode 'live' to the transport; the MCP paper gate had been fixed the same afternoon and these two doors had not
